messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live data and can’t tell you who the current top‑ranked tennis player is as of today. However, if you’d like, I can share the most recent ATP/WTA rankings that I have from my last update.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?" We need to retrieve the current ranking. The tool sports_team_standing is for sports teams, not individual players. There's no tool for retrieving individual player rankings. So we cannot use the tool. We can answer based on knowledge up to 2024-06. But the question is about "currently" as of now (2026-07). Our knowledge cutoff is 2024-06, so we don't know the current ranking in 2026. We should respond that we can't provide real-time data. According to policy, we should say we don't have real-time info. We can offer to provide historical ranking or approximate. But we should not hallucinate. So we should say we don't have real-time data.
